rules: Routine birth/death change may be aggregated at LOD; mass-casualty or mass-migration changes require explicit records.
Population never increases because a settlement/NPC is requested by gameplay.
Migration is movement, not duplication, and delegates to population_movement_contract.
Population capacity constrains sustained growth but is not a hard magical cap.
Species-specific lifecycle data may affect rates only through validated biology profiles.
Zero population does not by itself authorize an extinction history event; extinction requires causal confirmation.
